integrity: Exact four-cycle spectral derivation and spin-flip eigenvalue calculation; standalone symbolic and independent numerical verification included. Independent scientific review has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a three quarter-turn angles of a fixed-gate exact concurrence/optimization statement for the common pure-state Bernoulli-reset two-qubit process. It does not optimize across gate angles, reset states, resource costs or non-geometric renewal laws. The p-to-zero limit is not an assertion of a unique state at p=0. Scholarly priority remains provisional.
title: Exact concurrence and optimal entanglement at quarter-turn resonances of a resetting two-qubit gate
